definitions.explanation: A system for organizing days and months, or a physical calendar or almanac. Often refers to the traditional Japanese calendar system and its seasonal divisions.

examples.english: According to the calendar, it's already spring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旧暦|きゅうれき}→旧暦：12958_kyuureki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{暦|こよみ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{二月|にがつ}→二月：00657_nigatsu⟧ごろ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: In the old calendar, New Year falls around February.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧{暦|こよみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦{農作業|のうさぎょう}→農作業：14511_nousagyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めていた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother would check the almanac every year to decide when to do the farm work.

notes:
Refers to both the concept of a calendar system and a physical calendar or almanac. While ⟦カレンダー→カレンダー：02897_karendaa⟧ is the everyday word for a wall/desk calendar, {暦|こよみ} carries a more traditional, cultural nuance and is often associated with the old lunar calendar and seasonal markers.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {暦|こよみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ — according to the calendar
- ⟦{旧暦|きゅうれき}→旧暦：12958_kyuureki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{暦|こよみ} — the old (lunar) calendar
- {暦|こよみ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧ — to check the almanac
- {暦|こよみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{春|はる}→春：00627_haru⟧ — spring by the calendar (but not yet in reality)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦カレンダー→カレンダー：02897_karendaa⟧ — calendar (modern wall/desk calendar)
- ⟦{旧暦|きゅうれき}→旧暦：12958_kyuureki⟧ — old/lunar calendar
- {新暦|しんれき} — new/Gregorian calendar
- ⟦{二十四節気|にじゅうしせっき}→二十四節気：25146_nijuushisekki⟧ — the 24 solar terms (traditional seasonal divisions)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan adopted the Gregorian calendar in 1873, but the old lunar calendar (⟦{旧暦|きゅうれき}→旧暦：12958_kyuureki⟧) still influences festivals and seasonal customs. The phrase {暦|こよみ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ is commonly used when the calendar date says one season but the weather feels like another.
